passages.provision_quote: an owner of residential real property shall not, over the course of any 12-month period, increase the gross rental rate for a dwelling or a unit more than 5 percent plus the percentage change in the cost of living, or 10 percent, whichever is lower, of the lowest gross rental rate charged for that dwelling or unit at any time during the 12 months prior to the effective date of the increase.
passages.note: Sets a statewide rent cap and just-cause eviction requirement applying broadly, with specified exemptions (new construction, single-family, deed-restricted affordable, etc.).
Assembly floor vote concurring in Senate amendments to AB 1482; Wicks voted Aye, 48-26.
passages.actor_quote: Mark Stone, Ting, Weber, Wicks, Wood, Rendon
passages.tally_quote: Ayes Count 48 Noes Count 26 NVR Count 5

rows.reasoning: AB 1482 (2019-2020) caps annual rent increases statewide at 5 percent plus CPI (or 10 percent, whichever is lower) and adds just-cause eviction protections, extending rent-cap and tenant-protection coverage to units across California that previously had none, while exempting new construction, single-family owner-occupied homes, and already-restricted affordable units — matching 'Strengthen existing rent stabilization and extend coverage to more units' and excluding rungs that require covering all units, limiting to subsidized units, or opposing regulation. Wicks voted Aye on the Assembly floor concurrence (48-26).
